## Description

Trains a recurrent neural network via reinforcement learning to dynamically hedge derivative portfolios in the presence of realistic market frictions and transaction costs.

## Where it may fit

Illiquid options books, exotic derivatives portfolios, high-volatility crash periods with wide bid-ask spreads.

## Vehicles

Institutional options market makers, structured products desks, quantitative hedge funds.

## Required data

Option Greeks, spot paths, implied volatility surfaces, historical bid-ask spread data.

## Caveats

Requires intensive GPU training on simulated Monte Carlo price paths; model performance depends heavily on simulator fidelity.
